sections.heading: Depth you cannot see is depth you cannot use.
sections.body:
Closets, laundry rooms and garages all share the same flaw as a kitchen cabinet: the back half is dead space. Deep fixed shelves stack four high and lose the bottom two to whatever landed in front.

Glide-outs turn that depth into the point. A designer measures each space — the run, the door swing, the height you can still reach — and every shelf is cut to that one opening in our own shop.

items.question: Do you have to replace my closet?
items.answer: No. The glide-outs fit inside the closet, cupboard or garage shelving you already have. The framing stays where it is.

items.question: Will they fit an awkward or angled space?
items.answer: Usually yes, and that is the point of measuring on site. Under-stairs and angled ceilings are exactly where a built-to-fit shelf earns its place.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Standard glides are rated to **100 lb**, and heavy-duty runners for garage and storage go well beyond that. We spec to what you load.

items.question: How long does a closet take to install?
items.answer: Most closets are done in a morning. A full garage or several rooms can run to a day, and we tell you which before you book.

items.question: What is the warranty?
items.answer: Lifetime on the glide hardware for as long as you own the home. Shelves themselves carry a five year warranty against defects.
